services.name: Princeton Pickleball Courts
services.desc: Welcome to the Princeton Pickleball Courts in Memorial Park next to Centennial Outdoor Pool at 221 Hwy 3. Enjoy outdoor play from mid April to October each year. The courts are available free of charge from 8:00am to 8:00pm daily. Pickleball facility guidelines are posted at the courts. The Princeton Pickleball Courts came to life from the dedication and determination of the Princeton Pickleball Association. This group is passionate about their sport, and like true small town spirit, built this fabulous new facility with the Town of Princeton, local contractors, and community volunteers. Funding from the Town of Princeton, RDOS, Weyerhaeuser, Hudbay Copper Mountain Mine, Save On Foods,
